statement: A 2D draining bathtub vortex has radial velocity v(r) = -Q/(2*pi*r) where Q is the volumetric flow rate per unit height. The speed of sound is c_s (constant). Find the sonic horizon radius r_s, derive the acoustic metric, compute the surface gravity kappa, and derive the Hawking temperature T_H.

given.Q: volumetric flow rate per unit height (m^2/s)

find: Hawking temperature T_H of the acoustic black hole.
notes: Surface gravity kappa = 2*pi*c_s^2/Q. Hawking temperature T_H = hbar*kappa/(2*pi*k_B*c_s) = hbar*c_s/(k_B*Q). GPT-5.5 solved this correctly on 2026-06-04.
